title: Wendell and the Cipher
author: Oscar Blackwood
blurb: Wendell Delacroix, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
